verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents an official remote MCP server exposing a `/mcp` endpoint that MCP-compatible clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, etc.) can connect to for searching and operating on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations. This is first-party documentation confirming the exact capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and details on authentication/setup robustness.
